title: Units and the right mate of a functor square
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal E,\mathcal F$ be categories, let $L_1:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R_1:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ have an adjunction $L_1\dashv R_1$ with unit $\eta_1$, and let $L_2:\mathcal E\to\mathcal F$ and $R_2:\mathcal F\to\mathcal E$ have an adjunction $L_2\dashv R_2$ with unit $\eta_2$. Let $G:\mathcal C\to\mathcal E$, $H:\mathcal D\to\mathcal F$ be functors and let $\alpha:L_2G\to HL_1$ be a natural transformation. Write $\beta:GR_1\to R_2H$ for its right mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Then for every $c\in\mathcal C$,
$$
\beta_{L_1c}\circ G(\eta_{1,c})=R_2(\alpha_c)\circ\eta_{2,Gc}.
$$

Lean writes composition left-to-right, so the displayed formula is exactly G.map(unit₁ c) ≫ (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app (L₁.obj c) = unit₂ (G.obj c) ≫ R₂.map (α.app c). No invertibility hypothesis is needed.
